raw_event.resolution: Use floatmax(Float32) for reset and zero-score marker, preserving finite native marker. No change to calculated nonzero score formula or1e-3 tolerance.

raw_event.capture_limit: Raw log retained; malformed Inf trial record not retained as valid artifact.
